claim.spatial_precision: documented sectors including agriculture and brick kilns; country entity is index only
claim.summary: An ILO working paper documented continuing debt bondage in Pakistan during the 1990s despite national legislation banning the practice, including evidence from agriculture and brick kilns. The atlas records a positive debt-bondage claim for the 1990s without inferring a uniform national prevalence or practice polygon.

source.title: Bonded labour in Pakistan
source.geographic_scope: Pakistan; especially agriculture and brick-kiln bonded labour
source.independence_notes: ILO working paper synthesizing the continuing bonded-labour problem and legal framework; its internal examples are one evidence package for this claim.
